ledger_capture_buffer_busy.description: The capture queue's memory segment crossed watermark tier 1 (segment_edge started) or fell back below its release line (ended, with the duration); the flush thread uses larger batches meanwhile (Workflow #383 AO-2).
ledger_capture_buffer_busy.common_causes: A burst of records or a slow disk.

ledger_capture_buffer_overloaded.description: The capture queue crossed watermark tier 3: spilling does not keep up and everything but the batch in flight is spilled; business is not paused (Workflow #383 AO-2).
ledger_capture_buffer_overloaded.common_causes: The disk is too slow for the record rate, or it is failing.
ledger_capture_buffer_overloaded.handling: Look at the disk now; if it fails, the Runtime stops with ledger_write_failed.

ledger_capture_spilled.description: The capture queue crossed watermark tier 2: the oldest records are being spilled to the dump file (started) or spilling stopped (ended, with records and bytes spilled); nothing is dropped (Workflow #383 AO-2).
ledger_capture_spilled.common_causes: The flush thread cannot keep up, usually because the disk is slow or busy.
ledger_capture_spilled.handling: Check the disk that holds the state root if it recurs.

ledger_database_root_mismatch.description: The ledger reports ledger database root mismatch.

ledger_dump_failed.description: After a failed ledger write the dump could be written neither in the state root nor in the fallback folder (paths: both places tried); the unflushed records are lost and the next start writes a tail gap (Workflow #383 AO-1).
ledger_dump_failed.common_causes: Both the state root's disk and the system disk are full or unwritable.
ledger_dump_failed.handling: Free space or repair the disks, then start the Runtime again.

ledger_dump_imported.description: At start the ledger imported a dump file left by an earlier run: count records appended, duplicate_count skipped because their event id was already in the ledger; dump_sealed tells whether the dump ended with its trailer. The dump file is deleted after this record is committed (Workflow #383 AO-1).
ledger_dump_imported.common_causes: The previous run stopped after a failed ledger write, or crashed while records were spilled to the dump.
ledger_dump_imported.handling: None; look for the cause of the previous stop.

ledger_dump_incomplete.description: A dump file without its trailer ended in a truncated line: its verified part was imported and a gap record covers the rest, from the last verified record to the dump's last modification; the number of lost records is unknown (Workflow #383 AO-1).
ledger_dump_incomplete.common_causes: The process ended while it was spilling records to the dump.
ledger_dump_incomplete.handling: None for the ledger; the gap record marks the time range whose records are missing.

ledger_dump_invalid.description: A line in the middle of a dump file does not match its hash: the verified prefix was imported, a gap record covers the rest and the file was renamed to kept_path, unchanged (Workflow #383 AO-1).
ledger_dump_invalid.common_causes: The dump file was damaged on disk or edited.
ledger_dump_invalid.handling: Keep the renamed file for inspection and check the disk; the Runtime keeps working.

ledger_dump_unsupported.description: The dump file at path declares a dump_version newer than this build reads; the Runtime refuses to start and leaves the file untouched (Workflow #383 AO-1).
ledger_dump_unsupported.common_causes: A newer Runtime wrote the dump and an older one was started on the same state root.
ledger_dump_unsupported.handling: Start the Runtime build that wrote the dump so that it imports it.

ledger_flush_delayed.description: The oldest unflushed record became older than flush_lag_warn_ms (started) or the lag fell back (ended) (Workflow #383 AO-8).
ledger_flush_delayed.common_causes: A slow disk or long reads that delay the writer.
ledger_flush_delayed.handling: None while it ends soon; check the disk if it recurs.

ledger_record_rejected.description: One captured record failed assembly or sanitizing on the flush thread and was not written; a single-record gap takes its place. For a revisioned source the gap names its revision so the continuity check accepts the hole (Workflow #383 AO-2).
ledger_record_rejected.common_causes: A Runtime bug: a payload the ledger refuses to store.
ledger_record_rejected.handling: Report it as a Runtime bug with the event id; business continued.

ledger_store_mismatch.description: A sampled key's current value in a memory store (actual) differs from the latest committed record of that key in the ledger index (expected), at a revision already committed; neither side is changed and each stretch is reported once (Workflow #383 AO-8).
ledger_store_mismatch.common_causes: A Runtime bug: a store change that was not captured, or a capture that does not match the change.
ledger_store_mismatch.handling: Report it as a Runtime bug with the key and both revisions.

ledger_store_revision_skipped.description: A revisioned source's records in the ledger jumped from expected_revision to source_revision without a gap record covering the hole: a business change reached the store without passing its gate (Workflow #383 AO-2, AO-8).
ledger_store_revision_skipped.common_causes: A Runtime bug: a write path that bypasses the capture interface.
ledger_store_revision_skipped.handling: Report it as a Runtime bug; the store and the ledger are left as they are.

ledger_tag_index_mismatch.description: An index row of the ledger points at a record whose key or value hash differs from the row; the persisted state breaks an invariant and the Runtime refuses to start (Workflow #383 AO-6).
ledger_tag_index_mismatch.common_causes: A damaged or edited state root, or a Runtime bug in index maintenance.
ledger_tag_index_mismatch.handling: Restore the state root from a backup or report it as a Runtime bug; do not edit the database by hand.

ledger_tag_key_unclassified.description: A workbench key matched neither ledger_observer.tag.workbench_patterns nor tag.reobserve_prefixes, so it is not tagged and will not survive a restart; reported once per prefix (Workflow #383 AO-5).
ledger_tag_key_unclassified.common_causes: A new workbench key was added without classifying it.
ledger_tag_key_unclassified.handling: Add the key to one of the two configuration lists.

ledger_tagged_entries_dropped.description: At start count tagged entries of instances that are no longer in the configuration were not loaded (Workflow #383 AO-6).
ledger_tagged_entries_dropped.common_causes: An instance was removed from the configuration.

ledger_tagged_state_loaded.description: At start the memory stores were loaded from the ledger index and the records it points to: count keys, event_count records read, per source in source_counts (Workflow #383 AO-6).

ledger_tagged_state_seeded.description: The first start of a build with tagged loading on a ledger with history replayed the history once and wrote count value records for the tagged keys (Workflow #383 AO-5).
ledger_tagged_state_seeded.common_causes: Upgrading to the build that brings tagged loading.

ledger_tail_unconfirmed.description: The previous run ended without a close record and without a complete dump: a gap record covers the time from its last committed record to this start; the number of lost records is unknown (Workflow #383 AO-2).
ledger_tail_unconfirmed.common_causes: The process was killed, crashed or lost power.
ledger_tail_unconfirmed.handling: None for the ledger; effects done just before the end may have no record.

ledger_transaction_owner_mismatch.description: The ledger reports ledger transaction owner mismatch.

ledger_view_schema_mismatch.description: The ledger reports ledger view schema mismatch.

ledger_write_failed.description: Every configured attempt to write a batch failed, or one attempt stalled beyond flush_attempt_stall_ms (then timeout_ms is set). The ledger wrote every unflushed record to the dump file (path) and the Runtime stopped; the next start imports the dump (Workflow #383 AO-1).
ledger_write_failed.common_causes: A full disk, a broken file system, a ledger file another program holds or a hung storage device.
ledger_write_failed.handling: Repair the disk or the ledger file, then start the Runtime again; it imports the dump before it opens for work. Do not delete the dump file.

ledger_write_retried.description: Writing a batch of captured records failed and was retried after reading the ledger back; the batch was committed in the end. Reported once per stretch of retries with the number of attempts (Workflow #383 AO-1).
ledger_write_retried.common_causes: A short I/O error, a busy database or a slow disk.
ledger_write_retried.handling: No action while it stays rare; frequent reports point at the disk that holds the state root.
